item.title: Where to celebrate St. Patrick's Day in Las Vegas
item.description: St. Patrick's Day is just around the corner and with it, most of the country celebrates the return of spring. While here in the desert of Las Vegas the weather may be telling a different story, there are still plenty of places to celebrate your Irish heritage or at least wear green and pretend.

item.title: Family of boy slain during Las Vegas police shooting plans to sue Metro
item.description: The family of a young boy shot and killed during an incident involving police and the boy's father plans to sue the Las Vegas Metropolitan Police Department, the family said Friday.

item.title: Southern Nevada bicycle coalition launches 'Let’s Get There Together' campaign
item.description: A renewed push is underway to make southern Nevada’s roads safer for everyone. The Southern Nevada Bicycle Coalition launched the third installment of its “Let’s Get There Together” campaign, focused on shared responsibility and the goal of zero traffic fatalities.

item.title: What to know for the Mint 400 in Las Vegas
item.description: Las Vegas is home to a variety car races including Formula 1, NASCAR and NHRA drag racing - but for one week in the spring attention turns south of the Strip to the off-road Mint 400 in the desert.

item.title: Near record highs Saturday and Sunday before winds move in
item.description: Expect a warm weekend in Las Vegas as temperatures peak Saturday and Sunday. The valley is seeing mostly clear skies with light breezes.

item.title: What $100 actually gets you in Las Vegas in 2026 -- from the Strip to hidden gems
item.description: In Las Vegas, $100 can mean very different things depending on where you spend it.

item.title: Toucan seen flying around Las Vegas has been rescued
item.description: A toucan that has been seen flying around Las Vegas for months has been saved, a bird rescue group said Wednesday.

item.title: Las Vegas business owner sentenced in $4M fraud scheme
item.description: A Las Vegas business owner has been sentenced to four years in federal prison after prosecutors say he carried out a multimillion-dollar Ponzi-style fraud scheme that targeted a food brokerage company.

item.title: Trump says Iran Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei is dead, Israel confirms
item.description: Trump called Khamenei “one of the most evil people in history.”

item.title: Nye County deputies arrest suspect after ranch shooting
item.description: An active shooter situation was reported at Sheri’s Ranch when a man in a white Dodge Charger fired multiple shots at the brothel, striking the building.
